parameters.name: SLAVR
parameters.scientific_note: Specific leaf area ratio scale for reference leaf. Mutual-exclusive with SLAREF.

parameters.name: SIZLF
parameters.scientific_note: Maximum size (area) of an individual leaf. Mutual-exclusive with SIZREF.

parameters.name: VSSINK
parameters.scientific_note: Vegetative-stage source-sink strength scaling. Also declared in vegetative_partition module.

parameters.name: SLAREF
parameters.scientific_note: Specific leaf area reference (alternative to SLAVR). Mutual-exclusive with SLAVR.

parameters.name: SIZREF
parameters.scientific_note: Reference leaf size (alternative to SIZLF). Mutual-exclusive with SIZLF.

parameters.name: LAREA_EARLY
parameters.init_source: SPE leaf expansion YVREF array, early anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Early-stage anchor of YVREF (node-area reference array).

parameters.name: LAREA_MID
parameters.init_source: SPE leaf expansion YVREF array, mid anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Mid-stage anchor of YVREF (node-area reference array).

parameters.name: LAREA_LATE
parameters.init_source: SPE leaf expansion YVREF array, late anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Late-stage anchor of YVREF (node-area reference array).

parameters.name: LEAF_PART_EARLY
parameters.init_source: SPE partition YLEAF array, early anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Early-stage leaf partition fraction anchor of YLEAF.

parameters.name: LEAF_PART_FLORAL
parameters.init_source: SPE partition YLEAF array, floral-stage anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Floral-stage leaf partition fraction anchor of YLEAF; participates in partition sum constraint with STEM_PART_EARLY.

parameters.name: LEAF_PART_LATE
parameters.init_source: SPE partition YLEAF array, late anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Late-stage leaf partition fraction anchor of YLEAF.

parameters.name: STEM_PART_EARLY
parameters.init_source: SPE partition YSTEM array, early anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Early-stage stem partition fraction anchor of YSTEM; participates in partition sum constraint with LEAF_PART_FLORAL.

parameters.name: STEM_PART_LATE
parameters.init_source: SPE partition YSTEM array, late anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Late-stage stem partition fraction anchor of YSTEM.

parameters.name: SLAMAX
parameters.scientific_note: Maximum specific leaf area under non-limiting conditions.

parameters.name: SLAMIN
parameters.scientific_note: Minimum specific leaf area (lower bound of SLA plasticity).

parameters.name: TURSLA
parameters.scientific_note: Turgor (water stress) sensitivity of specific leaf area.

parameters.name: NSLA
parameters.scientific_note: Nitrogen stress sensitivity of specific leaf area.
